user.title: Connect to the Energy Mapper add-on
user.description: The add-on is usually found automatically. Enter its address only if it was not, or if it runs outside the Supervisor.

data_description.url: Proposed when the add-on is installed on this Home Assistant (the address is also on the add-on's Info page). For a standalone container: http:// followed by the address of the machine and :8099, for example http://192.168.1.20:8099.

hassio_confirm.title: Energy Mapper add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the {addon} add-on?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. Check that it is started and that the address is right.
error.invalid_response: Something answers at this address, but it is not the Energy Mapper add-on.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: Energy Mapper is already set up.

init.title: Energy Mapper settings

data.grid_invert: Grid sensor is positive when exporting
data.battery_invert: Battery sensor is positive when charging

data_description.grid_entity: Power sensor of the whole-house meter, positive when importing.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Only for meters that report import and export as two sensors.
data_description.battery_entity: Power of the home battery, positive when discharging.
data_description.submeters: Power sensors of measured appliances: their power is subtracted before the analysis.
data_description.submeters_mode: Automatic: those of the Energy dashboard; remove one from the list to ignore it. Adding a sensor the Energy dashboard does not list makes the list your own.

data_description.switched_loads: Appliances whose state tells when they run, with those of the Energy dashboard. Add one or change it here; remove from the list one that comes from the Energy dashboard to exclude it. On-states: the states in which it runs (default on; off for a pilot-wire radiator relay).
data_description.excluded_switched_loads: Switches never measured nor proposed as appliances: those removed from the list above, or the relay of a deleted appliance. Remove one to measure it again.

data.adaptive_threshold: Threshold adapted to the noise of the curve

data_description.step_threshold_w: Smallest power change considered as an appliance switching.
data_description.night_step_threshold_w: Optional: smaller power changes, down to this value, are also kept while the solar panels produce nothing (below 20 W in the minute before and after). Between 50 W and the smallest appliance. Only with a solar production sensor; without one, lower the smallest appliance instead. Empty: off.
data_description.adaptive_threshold: Experimental: power changes smaller than the thresholds above are also kept when they stand out of the measured noise of the curve (at least 40 W and 4 times the noise of the last 30 minutes). Such small uses are listed apart in the daily report and are not proposed for review yet; everything else is analysed as without the option.
data_description.cold_appliances: Experimental, needs the threshold adapted to the noise: the small uses that come back regularly (a compressor that runs a few minutes, pauses, starts again) are learned in the quiet hours and followed through the day. Each such appliance is a signature of its own, proposed for review; where it cannot be followed, its energy is estimated from the rhythm learned at night and shown as an estimate.
data_description.peak_threshold_w: Peaks above this power are notable (for example the subscribed power). Empty: 80 % of the recent maximum.

data_description.analysis_time: A new time applies after the next analysis.
data_description.self_test_devices: After the nightly analysis, this many sub-meters are hidden in a copy of the analysis to check that the curve finds them again (shown on the Appliances tab). 0 disables it.
data_description.half_life_days: Age at which a past use counts half in the signature registry.

data.review_min_uses: Uses before a signature is proposed
data.review_min_days: Different days before a signature is proposed
data.review_wait_factor: "Wait": or after this many times more uses

data_description.review_repair: One notice in Settings > Repairs while signatures wait in the "To review" section of the Energy Mapper panel.
data_description.review_min_uses: The panel proposes a recurring signature once it was seen this many times, on at least as many different days as below.
data_description.review_wait_factor: For example 2: a signature put on hold after 6 uses comes back after 12 uses, or after the number of days above.
data_description.review_suggest_score: The panel suggests the entity of a signature when the entity's state changes at this share of the signature's starts and stops (at least 5 of them, on 3 different days).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. The settings were not saved.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on: start it, then open the settings again.

user.title: Add an appliance
user.description: Appliances found by the analysis are added automatically. Add one by hand when you already know it.

menu_options.add_relay: Driven by a switch (relay, pilot wire...)
menu_options.add_expected: Not seen yet: describe its power

add_relay.title: Appliance driven by a switch
add_relay.description: The analysis measures its power at each switching of the entity.

data_description.entity_id: The entity whose state tells when the appliance may run.
data_description.on_states: States in which it runs. Empty: detected automatically (off for a pilot-wire radiator relay).

add_expected.title: Appliance not seen yet
add_expected.description: Describe it: its first use will be recognised by its power.

data_description.power_w: The power written on the appliance, for example 2000 W for a kettle.

reconfigure.title: {name}
reconfigure.description: Linked to: {link}. Delete the appliance from its menu in the list.

menu_options.merge: Merge another appliance into this one

rename.title: Rename {name}
rename.description: The device, its entities and its energy statistic take the new name; their ids do not change.

link_relay.title: Link {name} to a switch
link_relay.description: From now on its energy is measured at each switching of this entity (it is linked to: {link}). The energy recorded so far is kept.

data_description.on_states: States in which it runs. Empty: detected automatically (off for a pilot-wire radiator relay).

link_sensor.title: Link {name} to a power sensor
link_sensor.description: The sensor measures it: it is subtracted before the analysis, and its sensors here stop (use the sensor's own energy in the Energy dashboard). The energy statistic recorded so far is kept.

merge.title: Merge into {name}
merge.description: The chosen appliance is the same as {name}: its links join this one, its past energy is added to this one's, and it is deleted. {name} keeps its name and entities.

error.already_linked: Already linked to the appliance {other}: merge it instead.
error.addon_too_old: Update the Energy Mapper add-on to 0.5.0 or later.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.

abort.not_loaded: Energy Mapper is not running: start the add-on first.

options.manual: Only the sensors of the list

signatures_to_review.title: Energy Mapper: signatures to review
signatures_to_review.description: Energy Mapper found recurring signatures that may be appliances (to review: {count}). Open the [Energy Mapper panel]({url}) to name them, wait for more data or ignore them. This notice can be turned off in the options of the integration.

takeover_removed.title: Energy Mapper: restore {device} in the Energy dashboard?

confirm.title: Restore {device} in the Energy dashboard
confirm.description: The appliance {name} had taken over the tracking of {device} in the Energy dashboard. It was deleted, and its energy statistic with it, so the Energy dashboard no longer counts this device. Submit to put {device} back as an individual device, where {name} was. Nothing else is changed; ignore this issue to leave the Energy dashboard as it is.

abort.not_loaded: Energy Mapper is not set up.
abort.nothing_to_restore: There is nothing to restore any more.
